gloss: everything; in all things; whatever happens

definitions.gloss: everything; in all things; all matters
definitions.explanation: Used to express that something applies to every situation or all matters without exception. Often used in maxims, advice, and general statements about life.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}も⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧だ。
{何事|なにごと}も⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧だ。
examples.english: In all things, the beginning is important.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}も⟦{中途半端|ちゅうとはんぱ}→中途半端：11305_chuutohanpa⟧にせず、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧やり{遂|とげ}げること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important not to leave anything half-done, but to see it through to the end.

notes:
A versatile expression commonly used in proverbs, life advice, and motivational statements. Adds a sense of universality—'in any and all things.' Slightly more literary and emphatic than simply saying ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧ or すべて.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何事|なにごと}も⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: everything is experience (a common saying)
- {何事|なにごと}も⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{肝心|かんじん}→肝心：21541_kanjin⟧: the beginning is crucial in everything
- {何事|なにごと}も⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧: as if nothing had happened
- {何事|なにごと}も{程々|ほどほど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: everything in moderation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すべて: everything — neutral, general-purpose
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: everything, all — colloquial
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: whatever it may be — more conversational
